items.title: What is Klick-Pro?
items.description: Klick-Pro is a marketplace that connects clients with verified professionals for local and remote work.

items.title: Is it free to use?
items.description: Posting jobs and creating a profile are free. Clients pay only the agreed price.

items.title: How are professionals vetted?
items.description: Every pro completes ID verification. For in-home services, we also run background checks.
